\[
\frac12.
\]

3. Its volume is consequently
\[
\left(\frac12\right)^3(216)=\frac{216}{8}=27.
\]

4. This small tetrahedron does not contain \(A\), so the part containing \(A\) has volume
\[
216-27=189.
